function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the current version of the application, including its name and version number, formatted in JSON. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieve details of a specific project by matching a given name and version. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The exact name of the project to be retrieved.

version.description: The specific version of the project to be retrieved, in the format 'major.minor.patch' (e.g., '1.4.2').

function.name: badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge1
function.description: Generates a badge indicating the level of policy violations present in a specified project and version. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_name.description: The unique identifier of the project for which the policy violations badge is requested.

project_version.description: The specific version identifier of the project to assess for policy violations.
